source.description: A pale blue wyvern-like ice drake with frost-veined wings half-spread, breathing slowly with freezing mist curling from its nostrils, wings flexing gently, tail swaying. Seamless loop.
The pale blue ice drake attacks — it rears its head back inhaling deeply, then blasts a cone of freezing mist and ice shards toward the camera, then settles back with wings half-spread.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
